question: Which failures can make a trained Korean next-token model scientifically inadequate as a source-conditioned writing proposer despite a successful token-stream receipt?

findings.issue: Proposal task mismatch: unsupervised FineWeb2 next-token training does not itself train source-conditioned rewriting or protected-cargo obedience
findings.risk: PIA failure may measure instruction-following or source-to-candidate interface failure, not an endogenous Korean language competence threshold
findings.mandatory_action: Freeze source-conditioning serialization (<src>/<ctx>/<cand>), candidate decoding policy, budget, and source-conditioned entry probe before checkpoint comparison; do not add task supervision after outcomes under the same confirmatory claim.

findings.issue: Exact record-ID/text hashes only protect sampled record identities; near-duplicate and paraphrase screening required by corpus-reservoir preseal is not materialized
findings.risk: PIA/heldout leakage and corpus train/dev semantic duplication remain possible even if recorded overlap equals zero
findings.mandatory_action: Treat near-duplicate exclusion as an unsatisfied presealed obligation; require source-surface near-duplicate certificate or explicitly downgrade adequacy inference and keep training authorization HOLD.

findings.issue: Generator-attested zero overlap cannot be independently recomputed from binary token streams and summary-only manifest
findings.risk: Independent Rust validator checks byte identity and declarations, not set disjointness
findings.mandatory_action: Future artifact may include sorted SHA-256 record hash lists or a Merkle/sorted-set proof sufficient for direct disjointness audit without raw text; preserve exact preselected token stream and do not silently replace it.

findings.issue: 100M tokens per checkpoint keeps exposure fixed but FLOPs, steps-time, gradient noise and optimal LR/compute vary with parameter count
findings.risk: Any observed capacity gradient is conditional on presealed optimization regime; not universal minimum competence or compute-optimal capacity
findings.mandatory_action: Report nonembedding capacity, total parameters, exact exposure, estimated FLOPs, wall-time/hardware separately. Secondary compute-matched experiment requires fresh prospective lane.

findings.issue: Decoder-only packed next-token objective across EOS document separators allows context from preceding documents unless attention reset is implemented
findings.risk: Synthetic cross-document information changes the conditional distribution; train/dev loss can differ by packing implementation
findings.mandatory_action: Declare whether EOS is prediction-only boundary or attention-reset boundary; confirm train and dev implementation parity and forbid undocumented semantics swap.

findings.issue: Diagnostic tokenizer-only sample and model pretraining stream may share source reservoir and stylistic biases, although record-disjoint
findings.risk: In-domain tokenization performance cannot establish general Korean genre coverage
findings.mandatory_action: Report genre/register and host concentration; PIA task family is not population representativeness.

findings.issue: PIA 24-task floor 18 repairable-or-acceptable with gross reject maximum 4 is a finite operational admission test
findings.risk: Measurement uncertainty and dependent cases limit precision; PIA_PASS is not evidence of human burden or broad quality
findings.mandatory_action: Keep task-family counts, confidence intervals, protected cargo veto and blind human adjudication; thresholds not retuned.

findings.issue: Raw web text packaging license is not blanket underlying-text rights clearance
findings.risk: Redistribution and deployment could require independent rights review
findings.mandatory_action: Keep raw text out of repository/artifacts, record source provenance, defer commercial/deployment rights claims.

non_actions: Do not change the frozen 100M/2M token allocation from audit alone.
Do not silently add supervised instruction data after PIA outcome.
Do not label engineering success as proposer adequacy.
Do not replace the existing canonical tokenizer or source packet.
next_scientific_step: Get byte-level artifact receipt; separately resolve R1/R2/R3/R5 with prospective contracts and checks before interpreting model-vs-governance experiments.
core_return_edge: P50 exists to identify governable Korean realization; building a generic LM without source-conditioned proposal evidence is enabling debt, not completion.
